 2026 midterm election voter guides from across the country NPR member stations are gathering information for voters — from voter guides down to local races. Scroll through to find your state and the resources available from your local member station. 
 Elections 
 Still need to finish your midterm ballot? Find your local voter guide here
 Updated November 3, 2026 12:42 PM ET 
 Originally published October 30, 2026 5:00 AM ET 
 By 
 Ameera Butt
 , 
 Kristine Malicse
 Ballot envelopes sit in a bin during the processing of ballots for the midterm elections at the King County Elections headquarters on October 23, 2026 in Renton, Washington. Workers have already begun processing ballots in Washington, which uses mail-in voting.
 David Ryder/Getty Images
 hide caption

 i 
 David Ryder/Getty Images
 It's the 2026 midterms .
 Beyond key Senate and House races , the NPR network is following governor races and ballot measures on abortion, LGBTQ+ rights, billionaire taxes, and more.
 More from NPR: Here's a look at the 36 races for governor this year 
 NPR member stations are gathering information for voters — from voter guides down to local races. They offer guides, resources and news reporting from communities across the country to help you be informed for this year's midterm election.
 More from NPR : With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well 
 Sponsor Message 
 More from NPR: These are the House races to watch in the 2026 midterm election on Nov. 3 
 Scroll through to find your state and the resources available from your local member station.
